audit.why: 50.55% over 455 games and the level chart gives Kled five of seven stages — a lane you steal at level 1 and then survive. The written arc matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-1 spike, the early text, whys[0] and wants.you[0] all say you beat 'an unmounted Kled before he has Skaarl'.
audit.why: Kled starts the game mounted. Riot's passive text: 'Kled rides his trusty steed, Skaarl, who takes damage for him. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts.' Skaarl is a second health bar he begins with, so the level-1 plan the page sells — burst him before the steed arrives — is chasing a window that never exists. It also inverts the danger: dismounted Kled is the weak one, and the page has it the other way round.
audit.corrected: The level-1 reason rewritten around Skaarl as a starting health pool you have to chew through, with the goal changed from a kill to dismounting him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Violent Tendencies is called sustain in three places, and wants.foe[1] has Kled 'dismount you'.
audit.why: Riot's Violent Tendencies text: 'Kled gains massive attack speed for four attacks. The fourth attack deals more damage.' There is no healing in it — it is an attack-speed window and an auto-attack reset, which is a completely different thing to play around: you back off on the wind-up, you do not try to out-heal it. And nothing in his kit dismounts an enemy; dismounting only happens to Kled, to himself, when Skaarl's health runs out.
audit.corrected: Violent Tendencies restated as a four-attack speed burst and burst tell, and the 'dismount you' line rewritten as Kled dismounting himself.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns, and Jousting is never mentioned even though it is his gap-closer and his escape.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11/10/9/8/7s at 800 range and yanks you only after the shackle holds for a moment — that delay is the whole counterplay window. Jousting is 13/12/11/10/9s and recasts to dash back through the target, so a Kled who has used the first half is committed for the return trip. Chaaaaaaaarge is 140/125/110s. Your Shield Vault is 13s down to 9s, so the Bear Trap and Jousting cooldowns line up almost exactly with yours — whoever spends first loses the next ten seconds.
audit.corrected: Bear Trap and Jousting cooldowns and the Jousting recast written into early and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault is recommended as the answer to Bear Trap with no statement of its limit.
audit.why: Aegis Assault is invulnerable from the front only, so it stops the trap damage but does nothing about the yank if he traps you from an angle — and the pull is hard CC, which cancels the channel outright. The page told you to block the pull; you cannot.
audit.corrected: Stated in early: face it at the trap, but the yank still cancels it.

edits.before: Your point-and-click W stun plus an auto out-damages an unmounted Kled before he has Skaarl — the one window you cleanly win the level-1.
edits.after: Kled starts mounted, so Skaarl is a second health bar, not a later arrival — but Shield Vault is point-and-click and it out-damages his level-1 back.

edits.before: Point-and-click W stun plus an auto out-damages an unmounted Kled at level 1 before Skaarl and his sustain are online.
edits.after: Shield Vault is point-and-click and out-damages his level 1, though Skaarl's health bar means you chunk him, not kill him.

edits.before: Violent Tendencies sustain and Skaarl-remount heal out-grind my empowered-Q poke through levels 4-5.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies is four fast attacks, not sustain, and remounting undoes my poke through levels 4-5.

edits.before: Win the level-1 with the W stun and an auto before Skaarl is up, then use E to block his Q skillshot
edits.after: Win the level-1 with Shield Vault and an auto, then face Aegis Assault at Bear Trap on a Rope

edits.before: Dismount you so his Skaarl-fear and remount reset the trade in his favor
edits.after: Bait Shield Vault, then Jousting in and recast back out through you

edits.before: Level 1 is mine — point-and-click W stun plus an auto blows up an unmounted Kled before Skaarl shows up, so contest the first wave. After that he flips it: his Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) yanks me in for a remount trade and a heal, and his Violent Tendencies sustain out-grinds my squishy frame. Use Aegis Assault (E) to block the Q skillshot — eat that pull and the lane is his. Don't trade into him while he's mounted and racking remount progress.
edits.after: Level 1 is mine, but not because Skaarl is missing — Kled starts mounted and Skaarl is simply a second health bar. Shield Vault is point-and-click and out-damages anything he has back, so contest the first wave. Then he flips it: Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) is 800 range on 11s and only yanks after the shackle holds a moment, and Violent Tendencies is four attack-speed swings, not healing. Face Aegis Assault (E) at the trap, but the yank cancels it.

edits.before: Through levels 4-6 Kled is the bully, not me. If he lands Q he gets the remount heal and the trade swings, and my empowered-Q poke doesn't stick to a champion who sustains it back on Skaarl. My R is for roaming, not winning this duel — when I'm pinned, leave with Grand Starfall and make another lane pay rather than feeding his remount. Only all-in when his Q is on cooldown and he's already dismounted.
edits.after: Through 4-6 Kled is the bully. If Bear Trap lands the trade swings, and chip does not stick to a champion who remounts it back. Count two cooldowns: Bear Trap is 11s at rank 1, Jousting is 13s, and Jousting recasts to dash back through me — once he spends the first half he is committed to the return. That gap is my window and it mirrors Shield Vault. All-in only while Bear Trap is down.

edits.before: This is where Kled buries me. His remount sustain and bruiser items shrug off my shields, and once he hits Skaarl with two items my burst plateaus while he keeps scaling. I can't 1v1 him here — my whole game had to be the early lead and R roams. Play for picks with the team, never side-lane into him solo, and don't trust my E to save a fight he can simply remount through.
edits.after: This is where Kled buries me. Remounting and bruiser items shrug off my burst, and Chaaaaaaaarge on 140s turns any side lane into a fight I did not choose. I can't 1v1 him — my game had to be the early lead and Grand Starfall roams. Play for picks, never side-lane solo, and don't trust Aegis Assault to save a fight: it only covers the front, and his trap comes from 800 away.

notes: REAL ERROR IN FOUR PLACES: the page had Pantheon beating 'an unmounted Kled before he has Skaarl' at level 1. Kled starts mounted — Riot's passive text is 'Kled rides his trusty steed, Skaarl, who takes damage for him. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts.' The page was selling a window that does not exist and had the threat backwards, since dismounted Kled is the weak state. SECOND: Violent Tendencies was called sustain three times. Riot's text gives it massive attack speed for four attacks with a bigger fourth hit and no healing at all — it is the auto-reset burst tell that _missing-interactions.json flags, and you play around it by stepping back on the wind-up, which is the opposite of the advice the page gave. THIRD: wants.foe[1] had Kled 'dismount you'; nothing in his kit does that. The packet's suspectName hit on 'Use Aegis Assault' in the early text is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is the correct name of Pantheon's E. I left the level chart alone; it already gives Kled five of seven stages, which fits 50.55%.
